analysis: Both supplied units are BASE-side text of CHANGELOG.md (lines 3454-3958): historical release notes for v0.9.x and earlier. The PR change is documentation-only, per the patch excerpt: it replaces the v0.10.7 candidate header with v0.10.8 and adds roughly 320 lines of upgrade and rollout notes near the top of the file (head lines 11-333). It contains no executable code, configuration, or permission changes. The supplied base text is unchanged context far from the changed ranges, so I found no changed-line evidence in these units. I considered the historical notes against T-041 (prefix-cache SSD tier, SEC-035). They describe encrypted SSD cache eligibility, TTL, scope and HMAC-keyed names consistently with the threat model's description, and they claim no weakening of the TTL, account scoping or kill switch. They are narrative only; the actual controls live in source files that are not in this batch. The patch excerpt is truncated, so the new v0.10.8 content (pair/cluster update, a two-Mac pairing, auto-update, coordinator pair-approval limits) is not visible to me and was not reviewed. Open questions for integration: if the new v0.10.8 text, or any accompanying code, changes auto-update, pair approval or the cluster trust boundary, that needs review against TB-002, TB-011 and T-053/T-054. Nothing here establishes a regression, so there are no findings.
